empty.title: Check every server in one pass.
empty.lead: Add your servers once. Daminus reads disk, uptime, databases and security over SSH, shows what needs a look, then disconnects. Nothing is installed.
empty.agentNote: Uses your running ssh-agent. Private keys never leave this Mac.

pick.body: Tick the servers from your SSH config. Nothing connects yet.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: One read-only pass per host finds sites, containers and databases.

group.title: Group projects
group.body: Pair front end and back end that live on different servers.

installed.title: Nothing installed
installed.body: No agent, no daemon. One shell script per scan, piped over SSH.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.body: Commands only read. Every one is listed before it runs.

secrets.title: Secrets stay put
secrets.body: Keys stay in ssh-agent. DB passwords are read from .env on the server.

errors.aliasInvalid: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash; start with a letter or digit.
errors.hostInvalid: Use a domain or an IP address, without spaces.
errors.userInvalid: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash; no spaces.
errors.identityInvalid: A path that starts with ~/ or /, without spaces.

addHost.title: Add a host by hand
addHost.context: Daminus never writes ~/.ssh/config. Fill the fields, copy the block and paste it there.

sidebar.ghosts: Projects and servers you add show up here, sorted by what needs a look.
sidebar.plainSshBody: Daminus uses ~/.ssh/config and the ssh agent, exactly like Terminal. It never stores keys or passwords; set up ssh once and every tool can use it.

ai.title: AI is off
ai.body: Scans work without it. Connect Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or a local Ollama to explain results.
